summary: Entering the End or the Nether after creating and reentering a debug world crashes the game
description: Regardless of whether you have entered the End or the Nether on your first entry on the debug world, reentering the debug world and using either the Nether or the End portal will crash the game. Nether Crash Report: End Crash Report:
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Enter the world and use the command to enable debug mode if necessary.
4. Save and exit the world to return to the main menu.
5. Re-enter the same debug world.
6. Use either the Nether portal or the End portal to attempt to enter that dimension.
7. Observe that the game crashes upon attempting to enter the Nether or the End.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 20w21a, 20w22a, 1.16 Pre-release 1, 1.16 Pre-release 2 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: When entering the End or the Nether after creating and reentering a debug world, the game consistently crashes. This occurs regardless of whether the player has previously entered either dimension during their initial exploration of the debug world. Upon reentering the debug world, attempting to use the Nether or End portal results in a crash, indicating a significant issue with the world state or portal mechanics. The crash manifests in both dimensions, as evidenced by the separate crash reports generated for each instance. It is important to note that this behavior is reproducible every time the sequence is followed, making it a critical bug that requires attention from developers to ensure stability in gameplay.
Expected Behavior: When entering a debug world and subsequently using either the Nether or End portal, the game should allow the player to teleport without any crashes occurring. Players should be able to transition between dimensions seamlessly, regardless of their previous interactions with those portals in the debug world. This behavior should remain consistent across all game versions, ensuring a stable experience when exploring different dimensions.
